articles.company_name: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
articles.summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust (NYSE: PEB) (the Company or Pebblebrook) today announced that Bill Bayless joined its Board of Trustees effective October 1, 2026. Mr. Bayless is the Chief Executive Officer of Maslow Campus Communities and a widely recognized real estate operator with extensive capital markets experience who helped build and institutionalize the modern student housing sector. Over his more than 35-year career, he has been involved in nearly $30 billion in real estate transactions. He co-founded American Campus Communities (formerly NYSE: ACC), a REIT, and led its growth from an early-stage platform into the first publicly traded student housing company. In 2022, he helped lead the companys approximately $13 billion sale to Blackstone. articles.title: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust Welcomes Bill Bayless to Board of Trustees
